items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Had a red bus with a trans-design John A. Riddler on the side of it.

ctx.x: A truck with the tap oil on the side of it. Snow and ice and everything. Yeah, sitting in the truck like that, you overcoat it when you're traveling. And then remember Desmond, Desmond had a model A-Ford bus, a model A-Ford. Brand new model A-Ford they bought, and they first came out in 1930. No, around the last part in 1929 I think they came out. Yeah, around 29. Yeah, in 29. I'm almost sure. I wonder how they bought a brand new one. Had a red bus with a trans-design John A. Riddler on the side of it. And the…
Nobody had heaters in the head. No, indeed though.
